title: pvDelaunay3D
body:
## pvDelaunay3D

Full native Delaunay 3D: tetrahedralizes input points (vtkPointSet) into an unstructured grid. Beyond delaunay3D it exposes which alpha-shape cell types are output when Alpha > 0 (AlphaTets and AlphaTris on, AlphaLines and AlphaVerts off by ParaView default), the Offset of the initial bounding tetrahedralization (default 2.5) and BoundingTriangulation. Alpha and Tolerance act as in delaunay3D (ParaView defaults 0 and 0.001).

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- A larger Offset makes a true convex hull more likely but increases the risk of numerical problems.
- Delaunay 3D can exhaust memory on large point sets; thin or clean the points first.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `Delaunay3D`. Identity: `filters/Delaunay3D`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input dataset to the Delaunay 3D filter. Accepted data: explicit-point datasets (polygonal, unstructured or structured grids) (vtkPointSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPointSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Alpha` | This property specifies the alpha (or distance) value to control the output of this filter. For a non-zero alpha value, only edges, faces, or tetra contained within the circumsphere (of radius alpha) will be output. Otherwise, only tetrahedra will be output. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `AlphaLines` | This boolean controls whether lines which satisfy the alpha criterion output when alpha is non-zero. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `AlphaTets` | This boolean controls whether tetrahedrons which satisfy the alpha criterion output when alpha is non-zero. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `AlphaTris` | This boolean controls whether triangles which satisfy the alpha criterion output when alpha is non-zero. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `AlphaVerts` | This boolean controls whether vertices which satisfy the alpha criterion are output when alpha is non-zero. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `BoundingTriangulation` | This boolean controls whether bounding triangulation points (and associated triangles) are included in the output. (These are introduced as an initial triangulation to begin the triangulation process. This feature is nice for debugging output.) | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Offset` | This property specifies a multiplier to control the size of the initial, bounding Delaunay triangulation. | `{"minimum":2.5,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `2.5` |
| `Tolerance` | This property specifies a tolerance to control discarding of closely spaced points. This tolerance is specified as a fraction of the diagonal length of the bounding box of the points. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvDelaunay3D",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
